device.description: 12-bit single-channel voltage-output DAC with 3-wire SPI-compatible interface, automotive (VSSOP-8)
device.note: dac6551-q1.pdf (SLASEB8C) p.4 pin functions (DGK), p.5 recommended operating conditions (VDD 3-5.5 V, digital inputs 0 to VDD), p.7 timing requirements and Figure 1 (SYNC, SCLK falling-edge data), p.14 power-on reset (zero), p.15 power-down modes (Table 1), p.16 24-bit input shift register (Figure 31: 6 don't-care bits, PD1, PD0, D11-D0, 0000) and SYNC interrupt

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC register; power-on reset fills it with zeros (p.14)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: PD1/PD0 (DB17/DB16) of the last valid frame (Table 1; 00 normal at power on)

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: Figure 31: DB23-DB18 don't care, DB17-DB16 PD1/PD0, D11-D0, then four 0 bits (accepted as don't care); executed on the 24th SCLK falling edge; SYNC high earlier aborts the frame (SYNC interrupt, p.16)

pages: p.4 (pins), p.5 (ROC), p.7 (timing, Figure 1), p.14 (power-on reset), p.15 (power-down, Table 1), p.16 (input shift register, Figure 31, SYNC interrupt)
notModeled: analog output, resistor string and output amplifier (VOUT never driven; VFB feedback input)
power-down output loads (1 kOhm / 100 kOhm / Hi-Z): PD1/PD0 are stored in CTRL.PD only; the DAC register is kept as the datasheet says
the four trailing bits are shown as 0 in Figure 31; the model accepts any value
SPI mode 2 read from Figure 1 (SCLK high between pulses, data taken on falling edges); a continuous SCLK during SYNC high is fine for the model
power-down exit time (2.5-5 us), output settling time, SCLK limits (25/30 MHz) and setup/hold times
variants: dac6551-q1.pdf covers DAC8551-Q1 (16-bit: PD1, PD0, D15-D0) and DAC6551-Q1 (12-bit, left-aligned with 4 trailing zeros); same pinout. The skeleton device DAC6551 is the -Q1 part (DAC6551AQDGKRQ1).
